items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Cap, Sam, and I went to Tuggle Institute together. And, we also went to 'Bama State together. So, we were together all through those years... when we met up and originated the band in college, we just stuck together just like brothers. We travelled together... We started playing together

ctx.x: Bob Rance. He stayed in, we stayed kind of close together. I said that we went to Tuggle Institute together. And Cap, Sam, and I went to Tuggle Institute together. And, we also went to 'Bama State together. So, we were together all through those years. So, we knew each other as young kids.
A lot of the boys that I remember, Lee Stanfield, the bass player which was at Industrial High. His wife's grandmother was a teacher of mine in my kindergarten. That's how we happened to meet.
